pr_body:
In cases when contains query geometry is a point represented with  a geometry collection or a multi point, we return a `MatchNoDocsQuery` for cartesian point in ESQL. This is wrong as in fact can match documents. This commit unwraps the collection before doing the check.

fixes https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/110982
pr_title: [ESQL] Fix cases of geometry collections with one point in CartesianPoint queries
pr_comment: Hi @iverase, I've created a changelog YAML for you.

review_comment: I imagine an edge case where we have a multi-point, but all points are the same, or at least quantize to the same point.
indeed, this requires a bit more work but this is still an improvement.
I see this fix was already in the geo_point case from years ago. So this increases symmetry too.
